description: CSV query (filter, sort, select) — Filter, sort and select rows from CSV text with simple SQL-like conditions, offline. where= conditions joined by ' and ' or ';' using = != > >= < <= contains !contains startswith endswith in (a|b|c); numbers compare numerically ($ , % and (negatives) handled), text case-insensitively. Optional match=any, select= columns, sort= col or -col (several allowed, blanks last), distinct=true, limit= (default 100, max 5000), offset=. Returns matched count, rows, numeric summary of matched rows and CSV output. Up to 50,000 rows. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: util_csv_query
